title: Career Roadmap · Radiology Technician
summary: A Radiology Technician operates diagnostic imaging equipment, prepares patients for procedures, follows radiation-safety protocols and supports radiologists in producing diagnostic images such as X-rays and CT scans.

facts.Current degree: Diploma / degree in Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (MRIT) or an accepted radiology programme

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology; Mathematics may be accepted by some programmes.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Physics, human anatomy, biology, radiation fundamentals and English.

blocks.label: Entrance/admission
blocks.text: Merit-based admission, entrance examination or state counselling, depending on the institution.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: X-ray imaging, anatomy, patient positioning, imaging equipment and radiation protection.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Patient communication, accuracy, hygiene, attention to detail and safety awareness.

items.text: Diploma in Medical Radiology / Radiography → Entry-level radiography roles, subject to current recognition and employer requirements.
B.Sc. Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (MRIT) → Broader imaging education and career progression.
B.Sc. Radiography / Medical Imaging Technology → Diagnostic imaging roles where the programme is appropriately recognised.
Further study in CT / MRI → Imaging specialisation after the required foundational qualification and practical experience.

blocks.label: Radiologist pathway
blocks.text: MBBS → postgraduate radiology specialisation; this is a separate physician route, not a technician pathway.

India’s NCAHP notified a competency-based Diploma in Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (D.MRIT) curriculum in September 2026: a two-year programme for eligible Class 12 Science students with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, including a six-month clinical internship. Institutions must adopt it from 2027–28; early adoption is permitted in 2026–27. Verify the official notification and current institutional implementation.
